title: My pretty girl Noora
statementMd:
In Pavlopolis University where Noora studies it was decided to hold beauty contest "Miss Pavlopolis University". Let's describe the process of choosing the most beautiful girl in the university in more detail.

The contest is held in several stages. Suppose that exactly $*n*$ girls participate in the competition initially. All the participants are divided into equal groups, $*x*$ participants in each group. Furthermore the number $*x*$ is chosen arbitrarily, i. e. on every stage number $*x*$ can be different. Within each group the jury of the contest compares beauty of the girls in the format "each with each". In this way, if group consists of $*x*$ girls, then ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/90eda7186d150a31a8a1f356c79097a0591eb8c0.png) comparisons occur. Then, from each group, the most beautiful participant is selected. Selected girls enter the next stage of the competition. Thus if $*n*$ girls were divided into groups, $*x*$ participants in each group, then exactly ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73ee00e56876de3fc3efc21fb6d81038dff5ed20.png) participants will enter the next stage. The contest continues until there is exactly one girl left who will be "Miss Pavlopolis University"

But for the jury this contest is a very tedious task. They would like to divide the girls into groups in each stage so that the total number of pairwise comparisons of the girls is as few as possible. Let $*f*(*n*)$ be the minimal total number of comparisons that should be made to select the most beautiful participant, if we admit $*n*$ girls to the first stage.

The organizers of the competition are insane. They give Noora three integers $*t*$, $*l*$ and $*r*$ and ask the poor girl to calculate the value of the following expression: $*t*^{0}·*f*(*l*) + *t*^{1}·*f*(*l* + 1) + ... + *t*^{*r* - *l*}·*f*(*r*)$. However, since the value of this expression can be quite large the organizers ask her to calculate it modulo $10^{9} + 7$. If Noora can calculate the value of this expression the organizers promise her to help during the beauty contest. But the poor girl is not strong in mathematics, so she turned for help to Leha and he turned to you.

## Input

The first and single line contains three integers $*t*$, $*l*$ and $*r*$ ($1 ≤ *t* < 10^{9} + 7, 2 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ 5·10^{6}$).

## Output

In the first line print single integer — the value of the expression modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

Consider the sample.

It is necessary to find the value of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3ecc798906ae9e9852061ba2dd5cf6b8fce7753b.png).

$*f*(2) = 1$. From two girls you can form only one group of two people, in which there will be one comparison.

$*f*(3) = 3$. From three girls you can form only one group of three people, in which there will be three comparisons.

$*f*(4) = 3$. From four girls you can form two groups of two girls each. Then at the first stage there will be two comparisons, one in each of the two groups. In the second stage there will be two girls and there will be one comparison between them. Total $2 + 1 = 3$ comparisons. You can also leave all girls in same group in the first stage. Then ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fcc6c9e72a1525cc01abbfb89094669a9d37d3b1.png) comparisons will occur. Obviously, it's better to split girls into groups in the first way.

Then the value of the expression is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2c5a0f75c9d910ec77b2fe675e690de453060631.png).
statementZhMd:
在 Noora 就读的 Pavlopolis 大学，学校决定举办“Pavlopolis 大学小姐”选美比赛。下面将详细介绍选出大学中最漂亮女孩的过程。

比赛分为若干阶段。假设最初共有恰好 $*n*$ 名女孩参加比赛。所有参赛者会被分成若干个大小相等的组，每组有 $*x*$ 名参赛者。此外，$*x*$ 的取值可以任意选择，也就是说，在每个阶段 $*x*$ 都可以不同。在每个组内，评委会以“每两人比较一次”的方式比较女孩们的美貌。因此，如果一个组由 $*x*$ 名女孩组成，就会进行 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/90eda7186d150a31a8a1f356c79097a0591eb8c0.png) 次比较。随后，从每个组中选出最漂亮的参赛者。被选出的女孩进入比赛的下一阶段。因此，如果 $*n*$ 名女孩被分成若干组，每组有 $*x*$ 名参赛者，那么恰好有 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/73ee00e56876de3fc3efc21fb6d81038dff5ed20.png) 名参赛者进入下一阶段。比赛持续进行，直到只剩下一名女孩，她将成为“Pavlopolis 大学小姐”。

但对评委来说，这项比赛非常枯燥。他们希望在每个阶段将女孩分成若干组，使女孩之间进行的两两比较总次数尽可能少。令 $*f*(*n*)$ 表示：如果第一阶段有 $*n*$ 名女孩参加比赛，为选出最漂亮的参赛者，所需进行的最少比较总次数。

比赛组织者十分疯狂。他们给了 Noora 三个整数 $*t*$、$*l*$ 和 $*r*$，要求这个可怜的女孩计算下列表达式的值：$*t*^{0}·*f*(*l*) + *t*^{1}·*f*(*l* + 1) + ... + *t*^{*r* - *l*}·*f*(*r*)$。然而，由于这个表达式的值可能非常大，组织者要求她将结果对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模。如果 Noora 能算出这个表达式的值，组织者就承诺在选美比赛中帮助她。但这个可怜的女孩数学并不好，于是她向 Leha 求助，而 Leha 又向你求助。

## 输入格式

第一行也是唯一一行包含三个整数 $*t*$、$*l*$ 和 $*r*$（$1 ≤ *t* < 10^{9} + 7, 2 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ 5·10^{6}$）。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数——该表达式对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后的值。

## 说明

考虑样例。

需要求出 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3ecc798906ae9e9852061ba2dd5cf6b8fce7753b.png) 的值。

$*f*(2) = 1$。对于两名女孩，只能组成一个包含两人的组，其中会进行一次比较。

$*f*(3) = 3$。对于三名女孩，只能组成一个包含三人的组，其中会进行三次比较。

$*f*(4) = 3$。可以将四名女孩分成两个各有两名女孩的组。这样，在第一阶段中，每个组进行一次比较，共进行两次比较。在第二阶段中还剩两名女孩，她们之间会进行一次比较。总计进行 $2 + 1 = 3$ 次比较。也可以在第一阶段将所有女孩放在同一组中，此时会进行 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fcc6c9e72a1525cc01abbfb89094669a9d37d3b1.png) 次比较。显然，第一种分组方式更好。

因此，表达式的值为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2c5a0f75c9d910ec77b2fe675e690de453060631.png)。
